name: SAYE S.p.A.
note: Family holding company based in Genoa (per Racing Force S.p.A.'s board-list letter of April 2024, which also names Piero Paolo Delprato as Chairman and CEO of both SAYE S.p.A. and Racing Force S.p.A.). Racing Force S.p.A.'s shareholder table lists SAYE S.p.A. as the largest shareholder with 49.27% of the share capital.
